icj.name: International Court of Justice
icj.blurb: The UN's principal judicial organ, settling legal disputes between states and giving advisory opinions to UN bodies.

icc.name: International Criminal Court
icc.blurb: A permanent court trying individuals for genocide, war crimes, crimes against humanity, and the crime of aggression.

echr.name: European Court of Human Rights
echr.blurb: Hears cases alleging violations of the European Convention on Human Rights by Council of Europe member states.

iacthr.name: Inter-American Court of Human Rights
iacthr.blurb: Interprets and applies the American Convention on Human Rights across the OAS member states that accept its jurisdiction.

itlos.name: International Tribunal for the Law of the Sea
itlos.blurb: Adjudicates disputes over the interpretation and application of the UN Convention on the Law of the Sea.

ksc.name: Kosovo Specialist Chambers
ksc.blurb: A Kosovo court sitting in the Netherlands, trying crimes committed during and after the 1998–1999 Kosovo conflict.

wto.name: WTO Dispute Settlement Body
wto.blurb: The General Council sitting as the DSB, which oversees trade dispute proceedings between WTO members.
